name: Sicilian Defense: Accelerated Dragon
whenToShow: e4 c5 Nf3 Nc6 d4 cxd4 Nxd4 g6
principles: Use rapid fianchetto development to pressure central light squares.
Watch for Maroczy Bind structures and plan timely ...d5 breaks.
plansWhite: Control d5 and limit Black's freeing pawn breaks with c4-based structures.
plansBlack: Complete development quickly and prepare ...d5 under favorable conditions.
commonMistakes: Ignoring d5 control and drifting into passive setups.
Premature pawn breaks before piece coordination.
